I have verified everything needed. Let me compile the findings.

Key verified facts:
1. `sea-config.json` is referenced at build-exe.mjs:32 but does not exist in the repo (no file anywhere). This is a failure/pitfall — the build would fail at step 2/5.
2. Build pipeline: esbuild bundles web/app.mjs → build/board-bundle.cjs (cjs, node platform, .html as text loader).
3. SEA blob generated via `node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json` → build/sea-prep.blob.
4. Clones node.exe to dist/Plan Ledger.exe; on win32 kills running instance first (taskkill /IM "Plan Ledger.exe" /F), retries copy up to 15 times with 350ms sleep (EBUSY).
5. Strips Authenticode signature via strip-signature.mjs (zeroes cert table entry, truncates, clears checksum).
6. Auto-detects sentinel fuse by searching binary for "NODE_SEA_FUSE_" marker + trailing hex chars, rather than hardcoding.
7. Injects blob via postject with sentinelFuse.
8. Boot-test: spawns the exe with PLAN_LEDGER_WEB_PORT=4399 and PLAN_LEDGER_NO_OPEN=1, polls http://localhost:4399/api/plans up to 20×300ms, kills child, fails build (exit 1) if not served.
9. Port default 4319 in web/app.mjs and web/server.mjs; boot-test overrides to 4399.
10. /api/plans route exists in board.mjs (GET /^\/api\/plans$/ → store.listPlans()).

I'll report 3-8 findings.FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/build-exe.mjs#build pipeline","claim":"The exe build bundles web/app.mjs with esbuild (platform node, format cjs, .html loader text) into build/board-bundle.cjs, then generates a SEA blob via `node --experimental-sea-config sea-config.json`","evidence":"scripts/build-exe.mjs:24-32"},{"kind":"failure","subject":"scripts/build-exe.mjs#sea-config.json","claim":"The build references sea-config.json but no such file exists anywhere in the repository, so step 2/5 (SEA blob generation) would fail","evidence":"scripts/build-exe.mjs:32; repo listing has no sea-config.json"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/build-exe.mjs#exe clone","claim":"On win32 the build first taskkills any running 'Plan Ledger.exe' (/F), then copies process.execPath to dist/Plan Ledger.exe, retrying up to 15 times with 350ms sleeps to handle the Windows file lock (EBUSY)","evidence":"scripts/build-exe.mjs:34-39"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/build-exe.mjs#sentinel fuse","claim":"The SEA sentinel fuse is auto-detected from the binary by locating the 'NODE_SEA_FUSE_' marker and reading trailing hex chars, rather than hardcoding the documented constant","evidence":"scripts/build-exe.mjs:44-52"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/strip-signature.mjs#signature strip","claim":"strip-signature.mjs removes the Authenticode signature in place by zeroing the Security data-directory entry, clearing the PE checksum, and truncating the file at the certificate offset","evidence":"scripts/strip-signature.mjs:23-30"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/build-exe.mjs#boot-test","claim":"The build boot-tests the real exe by spawning it with PLAN_LEDGER_WEB_PORT=4399 and PLAN_LEDGER_NO_OPEN=1, polling http://localhost:4399/api/plans up to 20×300ms, and exits 1 (fails the build) if it never serves","evidence":"scripts/build-exe.mjs:59-74"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"web/board.mjs#route","claim":"GET /api/plans is served by the board server and returns store.listPlans(), which is the endpoint the boot-test probes","evidence":"web/board.mjs:28"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"web/app.mjs#port slot","claim":"The packaged exe's default web port is 4319 (PLAN_LEDGER_WEB_PORT env override), overridden to 4399 only during the boot-test","evidence":"web/app.mjs:13; scripts/build-exe.mjs:60-61"}]VERDICT: fail — build-exe.mjs references a missing sea-config.json, so the SEA blob generation step cannot succeed as committed; the rest of the pipeline (bundle, clone, strip signature, fuse detection, postject injection, boot-test) is coherent and verified.
